correctness.rationale: For n>=5, domination of both colors forbids 000 and 111. Distinct cycle vertices have at most one common neighbor; equal signatures outside either locating class must be singletons and occur precisely at cyclic 00100 or 11011. Thus allowed words have alternating runs of lengths 1 or 2 without run-length triple 212. Four-state weighted run automaton T and rooted-run count yield -x d/dx log det(I-T^2), with determinant 1-x^2-x^4-2x^5-x^6-x^8; correct n=4 correction and n=3 exclusion give the stated rational series. Its unique positive simple smallest-modulus pole (coprime exponents 2,5) gives asymptotic coefficient rho^-n, rho≈0.66099253189. Independently exhaustively checked binary colorings for labeled cycle orders 4..13, including n4 exception, and independently reconstructed rational denominator/coefficients via symbolic determinant; n>=14 analytical proof rather than extrapolation.
